title: refactor: split community endpoint helpers
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves upstream URL validation and OpenAI route construction into a focused module.
- Moves bounded image/video response handling into a focused media module.
- Updates consumers to import helpers directly without compatibility re-exports.
- Preserves behavior across all 95 community endpoint integration tests.

gist.headline: The helpers found their hive
gist.blurb: Community endpoint plumbing has been sorted into smaller, more sensible rooms. The bees still take the same routes; they just no longer keep every tool in one drawer.
gist.summary: Split community endpoint URL validation and OpenAI route construction into shared/community-endpoint-urls.ts, and bounded image/video response handling into shared/community-media.ts, while preserving all 95 integration-tested endpoint behaviors.
gist.impact: Developers get focused reusable helpers for community endpoint routing and media responses, with image, video, text, audio, embeddings, and OpenAI consumers continuing to behave the same.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed workshop where Polli organizes tangled API-route vines and media jars into two clearly labeled toolboxes: URL routes and media responses. Small code-plants and a CRT robot help show that the same garden remains healthy after the cleanup.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm garden-shed hackerspace: Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny tool belt, carefully sorts glowing code-vines into two lime green (#ecf874) labeled boxes, “URL ROUTES” and “MEDIA,” while a cheerful CRT monitor robot holds a passing test checklist beside healthy code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, subtle scanlines, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
